associations.rationale: The type states only the strict-dominance vanishing case; it does not state the stronger non-dominance theorem or identify strict dominance as its special case.
The type states the generalized non-dominance vanishing, but it does not itself state the strict-dominance special case or the relationship asserted by the complete source claim.
